subject: School Facility Naming Policy
overview: The Strategic Planning Subcommittee met to draft a district-wide facility naming policy and discuss community participation options for the McGlynn Elementary School playground. The subcommittee approved a draft naming policy for full committee review and recommended plaque-based donor recognition levels for the playground project.

items.title: Draft School Facility Naming Policy
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a draft policy governing the naming and renaming of school facilities, spaces, and grounds as amended, advancing it to the full committee for two required readings.

items.title: Community Participation Options for McGlynn Playground
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed fundraising and donor recognition options for the McGlynn Elementary School playground, recommending tiered sponsorship levels on a central plaque rather than naming individual pieces of play equipment.
